helpTip.ovPeriod: The date range you pick for the report. Monthly figures (progress, revenue, output) cover the whole months that have a day in the period; daily figures use the exact days. Example: period 15/07 - 10/09 covers whole months 07, 08 and 09.
helpTip.ovInPeriod: Projects being worked on in the period: the execution span (actual, otherwise planned) overlaps the period. Example: a project running 01/2026 - 06/2026 is present in the period 05/2026 - 08/2026.
helpTip.ovInProgress: Projects that have started and are not completed at the period end. Completed = progress reaches 100% and an actual finish date exists.
helpTip.ovBehind: In-progress projects whose actual progress is more than 5 points below planned progress at the period end. Planned progress = share of planned time already elapsed. Example: 60% of the time has passed but only 52% is done → behind (8 points gap). Amber: some projects are behind.
helpTip.ovPenaltyRisk: Projects not finished with 30 days or less left to the committed handover date (as of the period end). Example: handover 30/09, period end 10/09, progress 90% → penalty risk.
helpTip.ovPenalized: Projects recorded as contract-penalized. This figure reflects the current status and does not change with the period.
helpTip.ovNotStarted: Total contract value of projects signed but not started at the period end. Example: 3 contracts of 50 + 30 + 20 billion not started → 100 billion. This figure does not depend on the period: every contract signed up to the period end and not yet started is counted.
helpTip.ovRevenue: Total revenue of the months in the period, summed over all filtered projects. Months without data count as 0. Example: month 07 5 billion, month 08 7 billion → 12 billion.
helpTip.ovTonnage: Total tons processed in the months of the period, summed over all factories and filtered projects. Months without data count as 0.
helpTip.ovSpiCpi: SPI = earned value / planned value (EV/PV); CPI = earned value / actual cost (EV/AC), summed over the whole portfolio so larger projects weigh more. Below 0.9 is a warning (amber). Example: EV 45, PV 50 → SPI 0.9.
helpTip.ovSCurve: PV: cumulative planned value; EV: cumulative earned value; AC: cumulative actual cost (billion VND). EV below PV means behind, AC above EV means over cost. For months where a project has no data, that project uses its previous month figures.
helpTip.ovStatus: Projects in the period by status at the period end: Preparation (not started), In progress, Completed, On hold. Click a slice to filter.
helpTip.ovCapacity: Processed output in the period versus factory capacity over the same number of months. Above 85% of capacity is highlighted. Example: capacity 1,200 tons/year, 3-month period → 300 tons.
helpTip.dtAsOf: The month used to compute the figures on this page. Defaults to the latest month with data. If a month has no data, the previous month figures are used and labelled.
helpTip.dtPctPlan: Planned % = share of planned time elapsed up to the end of the month being viewed. Example: plan 01/01 - 31/12, viewing month 06 → about 50%.
helpTip.dtPctActual: Actual % = cumulative completed quantity, summed over stages by weight. Days behind/ahead = the gap between actual and planned % converted to planned days.
helpTip.dtSpi: SPI = EV/PV of the project. 1 is on plan, below 0.9 is a behind-schedule warning (amber).
helpTip.dtCpi: CPI = EV/AC of the project. 1 is on cost, below 0.9 is an over-cost warning (amber).
helpTip.dtResource: Number of people/equipment present on 1 day (the day shown below), summed over all contractors, NOT accumulated over days. Example: 520 people each day for 7 days is still 520.
helpTip.dtTimeline: The top bar is the plan, the bottom bar is the actual, the red line is today. Behind N days (x points) is the gap between actual and planned %.
helpTip.dtValueChain: Each stage has a weight (total 100%). Project % = Σ(weight × stage % complete). Example: Design 10% done 100%, Fabrication 60% done 50% → 10 + 30 = 40%.
helpTip.dtBottleneck: The first stage in the chain (skipping not-applicable stages) that is below 100%, holding back the whole project.
helpTip.dtMobilization: Actual mobilization versus plan on the day being viewed. Below 85% red, below 95% amber, 95% and above green.
helpTip.dtSCurve: PV: cumulative planned value; EV: cumulative earned value; AC: cumulative actual cost of the project (billion VND). EV below PV means behind, AC above EV means over cost.
